# Failure Handling in Compile Functions

The compile functions must handle failures gracefully. A failure in handling errors could lead to inconsistent state, where users might receive incorrect summaries or no indication of problems in the compile process.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py`
